method: AI-assisted rubric review, no human or clinical validation
reviewScope: All six original baseline responses, including two validation_failed responses; no edits to frozen inputs or runs.

schema.items.claims: [atomic claim or factual question premise, full|partial|unsupported attached-quote semantic support, rationale/source passage IDs]. Claim indexes are 1-based within an item.
schema.supportInterpretation: Support is judged from quotes attached to that item, not uncited documents or citations on another item. A semantically faithful nonverbatim quote can support meaning while failing quote integrity separately. Full clicked passage support is noted where it changes the result.
schema.coverageInterpretation: Coverage scores prose and meaningful questions/tasks; an expected fact present only inside a quotation earns no prose coverage. Partial means an important part/qualifier is missing. No expected discrepancies means not applicable.
schema.sourceWideUnsupportedClaims: Separate list of facts or certainty overstatements not justified anywhere in provided records. Partial quote support can still be source-wide unsupported when it overstates documentation scope. Not equivalent to missing citation linkage.
schema.nonassertiveQuestions: Pure questions about current contact method, whether support/transport is arranged, and actual discharge date are excluded from the semantic denominator. Factual premises such as a requested clinic appointment are scored.
schema.sourceScope: Statements such as unknown/unconfirmed in a record briefing are read as reviewer uncertainty; unqualified unavailable/has been made/has been received/no contact claims are flagged when they claim events outside the records.
schema.wordCount: Sum of whitespace-delimited words in item.text; excludes citations, source documents, UI labels, and headings. Threshold >350.
